column1: # Each row maps a case-insensitive regex `match` pattern (evaluated top-to-bottom
# in packages/orchestrator-core/src/prices.mjs; first match wins, so order matters)
# to an OpenRouter model ID from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models and fallback
# per-million-token USD estimates used when `openrouter_id` is `-` or absent from
# the upstream response (or when OpenRouter omits cache read/write fields).
#   `mythos` is an internal alias with no standalone OpenRouter listing).
# - `opus` and `haiku` keep legacy catch-all pricing behind `opus-5-5` and
#   is listed separately on OpenRouter at identical rates).
